d: India is rapidly expanding the role of private companies in defence manufacturing as it pushes to reduce dependence on imported weapons. The report looks at major projects, including the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) stealth fighter jet and the indigenous Suryastra long-range rocket launcher system. New Delhi wants private firms to account for half of India’s defence production capacity eventually. Defence exports have also risen sharply in the last financial year.
